decisions.rationale: Invoking an unspecified missing theory inadequately supports comparative plausibility, but it does not declare a proposition true solely because it remains unrefuted.
The unsupported extrapolation from clinical dissociation to cosmic individuation lacks a scale bridge, but does not demonstrate judgment insensitive to magnitude or number.
Reliance on one vivid case raises representativeness and methodological concerns, but no relevant background rate is identified and materially underweighted.
Oppy merely accepts a shared evidential maxim here; the card does not apply an exception or different standard to one side.
The text expressly describes conflating physical constitution with reduction of explanatory vocabulary, shifting the operative meaning of reduction to generate a contradiction.
The text identifies an unsupported inferential leap and missing premise, not an assumption of the conclusion within the premises.
The text describes an undefended extrapolation across scales, not a judgment that fails to vary proportionally with scale, number, or magnitude.
The text raises but does not affirm that classicality was presupposed; comparative plausibility lacking a complete interpretation is insufficient to establish circularity.
The text describes treating material ontology as necessary for objective experimentation although that necessity is precisely disputed by Kastrup’s external-realist idealism.
The text explicitly describes a generic point about all theories being descriptive that leaves the specific quantitative–qualitative challenge unanswered.
